sections.h2: What lead management does before a quotation exists
paras: Lead management is the part of the sale that happens before anyone raises a quotation. An enquiry arrives from somewhere, someone has to own it, qualify it, keep contacting it on a sensible rhythm, and either move it forward or close it. Aura Business handles that inside the CRM and Sales suite through Leads and Pipeline, Lead-Source and Conversion Analytics and the rep activity feed.

For medical equipment the cycle is long and multi-person, so the useful part is not a prettier list. It is that the enquiry keeps a source, an owner and a dated next action from the first call until it becomes a quotation, and that at the end of the quarter you can see which sources produced orders rather than which produced noise.

sections.h2: Lead management for equipment sellers, answered.

items.q: Can leads come in from our website automatically?
items.a: Yes. The Quote-Request Inbound module takes enquiries from your site into the pipeline with the product and message attached, so the rep sees what was asked rather than a bare name and number.

items.q: How does lead scoring work here?
items.a: Scoring is based on the qualification fields your team fills, such as equipment, budget stage, decision-maker reached and expected timeline. It orders the rep's list; it does not decide for them.
WhatsApp Business integration is part of the platform, and enquiries that arrive that way are recorded as leads with their source so the follow-up and the conversion reporting include them.

items.q: Can a manager see what reps did this week?
items.a: Yes. The activity feed, field visits with GPS check-in and the attendance module give a factual record of calls, visits and updates per rep. See field tracking.

items.q: What happens when a lead becomes an order?
items.a: It converts to a customer account, and the quotation, sales order, GST invoice and later the service contract all hang off the same record, so history is continuous. See quotation software.

items.q: Is this different from a general-purpose CRM?
items.a: The pipeline itself is similar. The difference is what sits behind it: catalogue, serial numbers, installed base, AMC contracts and GST billing, so the lead does not end at the sale. See the comparison.
